ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India's material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics, is acquiring the remaining 1.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited via a share swap agreement. This transaction will make Ascent Circuits, a PCB manufacturer with over Rs. 400 crore turnover, a wholly-owned subsidiary, enhancing Amber's control and operational integration. The consideration involves IL JIN issuing Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) to the seller, a related party transaction stated to be executed at arm's length.
